jackson-databind 2.18.6 is bundled inside ray_dist.jar, which is part of the Ray Python package. Airflow uses Ray only as a Python client library via vertex_ray from google_cloud_aiplatform to manage remote Ray resources on Vertex AI. The Ray Java runtime is never started within the Airflow container, so jackson-databind attribute modification code paths are never executed.

The image forces Jackson to 2.21.4, the latest published 2.21.x release, which remediates the other 2026-545xx jackson-databind advisories. CVE-2026-54515 is fixed only in the unpublished 2.21.5 patch release or the 2.22.x minor line, so there is no patch-only remediation available yet. Tracking Jackson 2.21.x for the 2.21.5 release.

The jackson-databind instances used by neo4j have been bumped to a fixed version. The remaining jackson-databind is shaded and relocated inside parquet-jackson JARs. parquet-jackson only deserializes its own fixed-schema metadata POJOs, which do not rely on @JsonView/@JsonIgnoreProperties filtering, so the property-filtering bypass is not reachable.
